Subject: Request: 48h fidelity safety-net for deterministic latency sweep

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough yesterday. Our SRE team wants to run a deterministic latency sweep across a couple of OpenEncoder variants to validate 99.9th percentile tail behavior under realistic caching and tokenization patterns.

Scope: 48-hour window (overnight + daytime), steady QPS at ~350 req/s (avg 60 tokens/resp), synthetic fanout to emulate 3k concurrent sessions.
Goal: exercise KV cache eviction and measure p99/p999 tail latencies across 8L and 16L models.

Can Redwood provide an ephemeral promo/top-up so we can run this against a Dedicated-like sandbox? We expect ~1.6M generated tokens/hour peak, so estimate ~80M tokens over 48h. If there are suggested model variants or a lower-cost quantized option you recommend, we can adapt the sweep.

I've attached a short plan (latency-sweep-plan.pdf) and a CSV with our expected QPS curve.

Please let me know the process for getting a temporary credit allowance and any constraints (regions, model variants, concurrency caps). We want deterministic results so we'd prefer a fixed window rather than an open-ended trial extension.

Best,
Natalie Park
SRE Lead, EdgeOps.ai
(attachment: latency-sweep-plan.pdf)

Hi Natalie — thanks for the plan, this is exactly the kind of test we like to support. A few quick clarifying items before I loop in capacity/sales: 

1) Can you confirm the exact time window/date you want the 48h to start (we allocate ephemeral headroom by window).
2) Do you require a specific region (us-west-2 preferred for lowest latency) or is cross-region okay?
3) Which model(s) do you want to pin for the probe (OpenEncoder-16L / OpenEncoder-8L / quantized-16L)? Quantized options reduce token cost but slightly change latency profiles.
4) Will you enable prefix/KV caching during the sweep? If yes, tell us the expected sequence lengths—we'll ensure cache policies match.

Operationally we can provision a temporary allowance rather than a permanent trial extension. I'll start a provisioning request (link below) but need Priyom to confirm the credit amount and Jonás (cc'd) to sign off on promotional eligibility.

Quick estimate: given your numbers I'd provision an initial 100M token allowance for the 48h window to avoid mid-test interruptions. If you prefer tighter billing, we can do 80M and monitor in real time.

Please reply with the exact window and model choice and I'll escalate.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Partner Solutions, Redwood Inference
